multisig.note: Single-key accounts only (BIP 44/49/84/86 templates); no multisig or shared-account flow

hw_signer.note: Trezor over Bluetooth; on-chain sends signed on the device. Only Trezor; bitkit-core's Jade code is never called

psbt.note: PSBT is internal to Trezor signing; only a hidden dev screen copies an unsigned one; no import, file, QR or share

watch_only.note: Paired Trezor accounts are tracked by xpub (balance, history); pasting an xpub or address works only in hidden dev settings

passphrase.note: Advanced setup adds a passphrase to a new wallet; restore takes an optional one; both feed the BIP 39 seed

coin_control.note: Manual coin selection setting; the send flow then lists UTXOs to tick and spends exactly those

fee_bump.note: Boost button on an unconfirmed on-chain activity: RBF for sent, CPFP for received; off for hardware wallet activity

taproot.note: Advanced > Address Type offers Taproot (BIP 86, bc1p); new wallets default to native SegWit

descriptors.note: Scanning a BTCPay SamRock QR sends the account's output descriptor to the store; no descriptor import or copy screen

own_server.note: Settings > Advanced > Electrum Server takes host, port and TCP or TLS; default is Synonym's bitkit.to

verifies_chain.note: Electrum sync through BDK, which checks merkle proofs against headers the server sends; no PoW, filter or block check

tor.note: Electrum client is built with no proxy; settings offer only host, port and TCP/TLS; no Tor or I2P code in the app

seed_standard.note: 12-word BIP 39 phrase shown for backup; accounts use standard BIP 44/49/84/86 paths; restore takes 12 or 24 words

cloud_backup.note: Settings, tags, activity and transfer records go encrypted to Synonym's fixed VSS server; no keys, no iCloud
